Class IosNonHittableTap

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.gui.element.internal.interaction.IosNonHittableTap
public final class IosNonHittableTap extends Object
iOS XCUITest reports element.click() as success when hittable is false and the control does not run. Both driver.element().click(locator) and driver.touch().tap(locator) call this after that reported click.

Recovery order:

  1. Element-anchored mobile: tap with the element id and element-relative centre coordinates (width/2, height/2).
  2. If page source is unchanged, a W3C touch pointer tap at the element's centre (viewport coordinates from WebElement.getRect()), matching the diagnosis in #6908 that a centre pointer tap reaches the control when element click does not.
Screen-only taps without an element rectangle are not used. Unreadable page source after mobile: tap fails closed with no further tap. When neither recovery changes the page source, the action fails instead of returning success.

Element id resolution prefers AppiumWebElement.getId() (Appium java-client 11) and falls back to RemoteWebElement.getId().
